Synopsis:
The House of Representatives is set to consider the "Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026," passed by the Senate 86-11. The bill targets Russian officials with sanctions and empowers Trump to impose tariffs on China, India, and other nations buying Russian energy. House passage is uncertain due to Democratic opposition, industry cost concerns, and Republican anxiety over midterm political fallout.
